instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow potatoes
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
¾ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Small dice the potatoes (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Transfer to a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 11 minutes. Once finished, drain the potatoes and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the onion to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.
Slice the mushrooms and add to the pot along with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp thyme
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp turmeric
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add the cooked potatoes and stir to combine. Sauté until the mushrooms are softened, 7-9 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Divide the potatoes and veggies between plates and top with minced parsley. Enjoy!
